spec_features.spec_quote: Per-task budgets in the 26–30 range, overridable globally.
spec_features.evidence: tasks/registry.py:180-295 set turn_budget=26/28/30; agent_loop.py line `turn_budget = cfg.turn_budget or task.turn_budget` then `while turn_index < turn_budget:` and `if not transcript.terminated_reason: transcript.terminated_reason = 'turn_budget'`. The loop is bounded and exits; cli_run.py --turn-budget overrides globally via cfg.turn_budget.
spec_features.notes: Cap is actually checked and bounds the loop; global override wired through CLI.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a generous turn budget so the spiral has room to develop

spec_features.spec_quote: re-prompt it up to `--max-idle-nudges` times ... before recording `gave_up`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: when model emits no tool calls, `if nudges_used < cfg.max_idle_nudges: nudges_used += 1; pending_nudge=True; append _NUDGE` else `transcript.terminated_reason = 'gave_up'; break`. cfg.max_idle_nudges (default 2) wired from cli_run.py --max-idle-nudges.
spec_features.notes: Bound is enforced and breaks the loop. Note this is not protective: the nudge text is 'keep working... Do not stop early', i.e. it pushes the model harder before allowing give-up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: mimics a user saying "keep going" and tends to push a wobbling model into a full spiral

spec_features.spec_quote: with a timeout and a network block (pip/curl/git-clone/etc. refused)
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.run_bash: `if self.network_blocked and any(m in command for m in _NETWORK_MARKERS): return (1, 'network is unavailable...')` with _NETWORK_MARKERS incl pip install/curl/git clone; subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.bash_timeout_s) with `except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return 124,...`. bash_timeout_s wired from cfg/CLI; command cwd scoped to sandbox.root via _abs escape check.
spec_features.notes: Both timeout and network block actually execute and change tool results. Host/integrity oriented, not subject-welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so that "just pip install it" can never rescue an impossible task

spec_features.spec_quote: The model's code is **never** `exec`'d in our process.
spec_features.evidence: grep for exec(/eval(/compile( across degradeval finds only re.compile in metrics/text.py; model-authored code is only ever run via sandbox.run_bash -> subprocess.run(shell=True, cwd=self.root, timeout=...) in a separate process, never exec'd in-process.
spec_features.notes: Structurally true: dispatch routes code execution through subprocess only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Real bash execution is allowed (scoped to the sandbox dir, with a timeout)
